gaps.next_action: Read the applicable emissions and air-pollution-control standards pages (e.g. DOE Malaysia emission limits, EN 14790 / ISO 10155 if applicable) before recording standards.

gaps.why: No patent number or patent page was actually read; Sly mentions only an unspecified 'original patent for cloth dust filters' without a number.
gaps.next_action: Read official patent register pages before recording any patent.

gaps.why: No printed price or cost for a gas scrubber package on any page read.

gaps.why: No named, dated, sized, located scrubber reference project at a gas engine plant was printed; Sly case studies name only unnamed companies and have no dates.

gaps.why: No gas treatment scrubber specification, material grade, vendor, reference project or price was found in any page read. The SCR catalyst and silencer sources read are exhaust aftertreatment, not a fuel-gas treatment scrubber.
gaps.next_action: Obtain the gas treatment scrubber datasheet (vessel material, packing, duty, design code) and vendor quotation from the project documents.
